real: Who the daily check rings: notDueReason (app/api/_lib/outbound.ts), the daily check's own test
Lane and refused refills: refillPreview, the real rule cards and lib/control/lanes.ts, read only
May we ring: control.checkOutbound, rule 7's cards (opt-in, 9 AM to 8 PM, one call per 3 days)
model: Risk score (0 to 100) from skipped and late refills, days already out, and missed calls
Early reach: high-risk patients (score 55+) are also rung 5 days before run-out
Who picks up, who asks for a pharmacist and who refills on the call, from each patient's past calls and refills
When a patient walks in on their own, sampled from their own refill history
Calls happen at the patient's preferred time: morning 10 AM, afternoon 2 PM, evening 6 PM
A refill that lands in Quick check or Review is assumed approved the same day
